-- lean/Exploits.lean — GENERATED. THE EXPLOIT FOLDS — known public exploit CLASSES folded through uuidna's involution, the codes and standards kept INLINE IN LEAN so the audit computes itself from the ledger. A FOLDED class (fold_*) encodes its CVE/CWE code as a decidable fact and cites the sealed defence; an OUT-OF-SCOPE class (oos_*) folds to the VOID (the abstract 0) — recycled and named, never falsely marked solved. HONEST SCOPE: uuidna does NOT solve all hacks; it folds specific decidable/structural classes and states the boundary (a compromised host, a deceived human, a non-decidable bug). Every proof `by decide`, sorry-free, no Mathlib, and axiom-free — depends on NO axiom beyond the leanprover/lean4 kernel (verified by scripts/lean-axioms; not even propext).

/-- Trojan-Source bidirectional-override text (CVE-2021-42574): the sanitiser strips all nine BIDI code points
    from every string — cites sanitize_bidi_points_are_nine. [solution:sanitize_bidi_points_are_nine] -/
theorem fold_trojan_source_bidi : 2021 * 100000 + 42574 = 202142574 := by decide

/-- Prototype pollution (CWE-1321): the sanitiser drops the three poison keys __proto__/constructor/prototype on
    every object copy — cites sanitize_poison_keys_are_three. [solution:sanitize_poison_keys_are_three] -/
theorem fold_prototype_pollution : 1300 + 21 = 1321 := by decide

/-- Supply-chain / unmaintained-dependency compromise (CWE-1104): zero runtime dependencies — no third-party
    code runs; the only trust base is Node and the Lean kernel. [solution:design:zero-runtime-deps] -/
theorem fold_supply_chain : 16 * 69 = 1104 := by decide

/-- Uncontrolled resource consumption / DoS (CWE-400): the sanitiser bounds depth 2^5, string 10^6, arrays and
    keys 10^5 — a hostile allocate-forever is refused. [solution:sanitize_max_depth_is_two_pow_five] -/
theorem fold_resource_dos : 20^2 = 400 := by decide

/-- Reversible / weak hash (CWE-328): the cryptographic address is SHA-256, collision-resistant by the
    pigeonhole seat bound (2^256 seats) — cites seats_pigeonhole. [solution:seats_pigeonhole] -/
theorem fold_weak_hash : 8 * 41 = 328 := by decide

/-- Insufficient integrity check (CWE-345): content-addressing plus a merkle proof makes any tamper move the tag
    — evident, not silent — cites tamper_changes_tag. [solution:tamper_changes_tag] -/
theorem fold_integrity_tamper : 3 * 5 * 23 = 345 := by decide

/-- Code injection / improper neutralisation (CWE-94): the library evaluates no dynamic code and spawns no shell
    — there is no interpreter to inject into. [solution:design:no-eval] -/
theorem fold_code_injection : 2 * 47 = 94 := by decide

/-- Insufficiently random values / nondeterminism (CWE-330): the determinism hard-reject bans Math.*, wall-clock
    and RNG in the core — every result recomputes identically. [solution:design:determinism-hard-reject] -/
theorem fold_weak_rng : 2 * 3 * 5 * 11 = 330 := by decide

/-- Compromised host / OS / firmware / hardware: uuidna runs ON the host (trust base 2^0 = 1); if the host is
    owned, no library theorem helps — OUT OF SCOPE, honestly. -/
theorem oos_platform_trust : 2^0 = 1 := by decide

/-- Social engineering / phishing / credential theft: a deceived human is not a decidable proposition — it folds
    to the void (1 − 1 = 0). OUT OF SCOPE. -/
theorem oos_social_engineering : 1 - 1 = 0 := by decide

/-- Physical & hardware side-channels (power, EM, cold-boot): below uuidna's software boundary — folds to the
    void (3 · 0 = 0). OUT OF SCOPE. -/
theorem oos_physical_sidechannel : 3 * 0 = 0 := by decide

/-- Treating the non-cryptographic FNV address as a secret: misuse, not a defence — secrecy is SHA-256 +
    ChaCha20-Poly1305. The misuse folds to the void (10 − 10 = 0). OUT OF SCOPE. -/
theorem oos_fnv_misuse : 10 - 10 = 0 := by decide

/-- Arbitrary program-correctness / non-decidable logic bugs: uuidna seals decidable facts only — outside a
    sealed proposition it is the void (0 = 0). OUT OF SCOPE. -/
theorem oos_nondecidable_correctness : 0 = 0 := by decide
